fulltext.LPC_CR_STAY_OFF: The vehicle shall always satisfy if preBool(false, !cr & kias >= 90.0) then !cr

fulltext.LPC_CR_STAY_ON: The vehicle shall always satisfy if preBool(false, cr & kias <= 100.0) then cr

fulltext.LPC_CR_TURN_OFF: Upon cr & kias > 100.0 the vehicle shall at the next timepoint satisfy !cr

fulltext.LPC_CR_TURN_ON: Upon !cr & kias < 90.0 the vehicle shall at the next timepoint satisfy cr

fulltext.LPC_DR_STAY_OFF: The vehicle shall always satisfy if preBool(false, !dr & kias >= 60.0) then !dr

fulltext.LPC_DR_STAY_ON: The vehicle shall always satisfy if preBool(false, dr & kias <= 70.0) then dr

fulltext.LPC_DR_TURN_OFF: Upon dr & kias > 70.0 the vehicle shall at the next timepoint satisfy !dr

fulltext.LPC_DR_TURN_ON: Upon !dr & kias < 60.0 the vehicle shall at the next timepoint satisfy dr

fulltext.LPC_FCS_STAY_OFF: The vehicle shall always satisfy if preBool(false, !fcs & kias <= 40.0) then !fcs

fulltext.LPC_FCS_STAY_ON: The vehicle shall always satisfy if preBool(false, fcs & kias >= 30.0) then fcs

fulltext.LPC_FCS_TURN_OFF: Upon fcs & kias < 30.0 the vehicle shall at the next timepoint satisfy !fcs

fulltext.LPC_FCS_TURN_ON: Upon !fcs & kias > 40.0 the vehicle shall at the next timepoint satisfy fcs

fulltext.LPC_INIT_CR: The vehicle shall immediately satisfy cr <=> (kias < 90.0)

fulltext.LPC_INIT_FCS: The vehicle shall immediately satisfy fcs <=> (kias > 40.0)

fulltext.LPC_INIT_HOVER_MODE: The vehicle shall immediately satisfy hover_control_mode <=> kgs < 20.0

fulltext.LPC_INIT_KIAS: The vehicle shall immediately satisfy kias = 120.0

fulltext.LPC_INIT_LIFT_MODE: The vehicle shall immediately satisfy lift_mode = wing_borne <=> kias >= 90.0

fulltext.LPC_LIFT_MODE: The vehicle shall always satisfy lift_mode = thrust_borne | lift_mode = semi_thrust_borne | lift_mode = semi_wing_borne | lift_mode = wing_borne

fulltext.LPC_REACH_HOVER_16: The vehicle shall within 16 ticks satisfy lift_mode = thrust_borne

fulltext.LPC_REARPROP: The vehicle shall always satisfy rearprop xor hover_control_mode

fulltext.LPC_STB_STAY_ON_NEXT: Whenever lift_mode = semi_thrust_borne & kias <= 40.0 & (kgs > 20.0 | !hover_control_mode) the vehicle shall at the next timepoint satisfy lift_mode = semi_thrust_borne
fulltext.LPC_STB_STAY_ON_pre: The vehicle shall always satisfy if preBool(false, lift_mode = semi_thrust_borne & kias <= 40.0 & (kgs > 20.0 | !hover_control_mode)) then lift_mode = semi_thrust_borne

fulltext.LPC_STB_TO_SWB: Upon lift_mode = semi_thrust_borne & kias > 40.0 the vehicle shall at the next timepoint satisfy lift_mode = semi_wing_borne

fulltext.LPC_STB_TO_TB: Upon lift_mode = semi_thrust_borne & hover_control_mode & kgs <= 20.0 the vehicle shall at the next timepoint satisfy lift_mode = thrust_borne

fulltext.LPC_SWB_STAY_ON_NEXT: Whenever lift_mode = semi_wing_borne & kias <= 100.0 & kias > 30.0 the vehicle shall at the next timepoint satisfy lift_mode = semi_wing_borne
fulltext.LPC_SWB_STAY_ON_pre: The vehicle shall always satisfy if preBool(false, lift_mode = semi_wing_borne & kias <= 100.0 & kias > 30.0) then lift_mode = semi_wing_borne

fulltext.LPC_SWB_TO_STB: Upon lift_mode = semi_wing_borne & kias <= 30.0 the vehicle shall at  the next timepoint satisfy lift_mode = semi_thrust_borne

fulltext.LPC_SWB_TO_WB: Upon lift_mode = semi_wing_borne & kias > 100.0 the vehicle shall at the next timepoint satisfy lift_mode = wing_borne

fulltext.LPC_TB_STAY_ON_NEXT: Whenever lift_mode = thrust_borne & kgs <= 20.0 & hover_control_mode the vehicle shall at the next timepoint satisfy lift_mode = thrust_borne
fulltext.LPC_TB_STAY_ON_pre: The vehicle shall always satisfy if preBool(false, lift_mode = thrust_borne & kgs <= 20.0 & hover_control_mode) then lift_mode = thrust_borne

fulltext.LPC_TB_TO_STB: Upon lift_mode = thrust_borne & (!hover_control_mode |  kgs > 20.0) the vehicle shall at the next timepoint satisfy lift_mode = semi_thrust_borne

fulltext.LPC_WB_STAY_ON_NEXT: Whenever  lift_mode = wing_borne & kias > 90.0 the vehicle shall at the next timepoint satisfy lift_mode = wing_borne
fulltext.LPC_WB_STAY_ON_pre: The vehicle shall always satisfy if preBool(false, lift_mode = wing_borne & kias > 90.0) then lift_mode = wing_borne

fulltext.LPC_WB_TO_SWB: Upon  lift_mode = wing_borne & kias <= 90.0 the vehicle shall at the next timepoint satisfy lift_mode = semi_wing_borne

note: lift_mode one-hot encoding: mutual exclusion of the lm_* atoms; no FRET source
kias threshold encoding: monotonicity of the kias_ge_N atoms; no FRET source
